newsitem.title: USA: Chase's Lieberman, Kleinman to launch hedge fund.
newsitem.headline: Chase's Lieberman, Kleinman to launch hedge fund.

text.p: Wall Street veteran Charles Lieberman, chief economist for Chase Securities, said Thursday he is leaving the Chase Manhattan Corp unit to launch a hedge fund with fellow Chase economist Sally Kleinman and two others.
Lieberman will join with Kleinman, economist Henry Kaufman and Joseph Oricoli in starting a macro hedge fund in New York City called Stategic Partners GP, LLC.
"We are going to play to our strengths," Lieberman said. "The group is high powered and we have a high quality analytical group. We are going to use that to anticipate market development."
The new fund will have an emphasis on the U.S. but will also be G-7 oriented, he said.
"It's something I have been thinking about for a long time," he said.
Lieberman will be managing partner at the new firm and do a combination of economics, strategy and investing. He had been at Chase-Chemical-Manufacturers Hanover for the past 11-1/2 years.
Kleinman will be head of research. Kaufman will run strategy, and Oricoli will run trading.
